nodes.text: Hello there, young builder! Our world has lost its colors. Grey is swallowing everything. But I believe you can help us bring it back!
Start small — light drives back the grey. Craft some torches and place them around our village. Here, let me give you a task.
The Dim Barrens grew from the east. Color just drains away there. Ancient beacons once kept the world bright, but they have gone dark.
The beacons need crystal shards and iron to rebuild. Explore, gather, and when you are ready, we will light them together. The world is counting on us!
Hey! Good timing. I am trying to fix up the village but we are short on supplies. Can you help me out?
First things first: you need a crafting table. Four planks in a square. Once you have one, stone tools and proper building becomes possible.
Nice work! With stone tools you can mine proper stone. Bring me some stone bricks for the walls — they look much better than cobblestone.

choices.label: I will get right on it.

nodes.text: Welcome! I study the plants and creatures of our land. The grey has been hard on them too — the animals seem frightened and lost.

choices.label: How can I help the animals?

nodes.text: You can befriend them with food! Woolly lambs love berry clusters. Befriend two and use their wool — I think it helps the lambs feel safe.
I make healing stews from mushrooms. The pine forest has plenty, but I am too busy here. Could you collect some for me?
